subject: planner: simplify the indexJoinBuildHelper structure (#55150)
summary: Reviewed diff vs parent: this is a refactor that splits the old `indexJoinBuildHelper` into read-only `indexJoinPathInfo` + per-build temp state, moving the index-join path analysis/range construction code from `pkg/planner/core/exhaust_physical_plans.go` into the new `pkg/planner/core/index_join_path.go`. Planner behavior/semantics for choosing/building IndexJoin paths appears preserved (same range-building logic, join-key matching/collation checks, and heuristic comparison). Plan-cache range rebuild plumbing is updated to pass the current `context.PlanContext` via `ranger.MutableRanges.Rebuild(sctx)`, which keeps correctness intact and avoids embedding a stale context in the cached range object.
